claim_ceiling: finite model-relative handoff of a declared surrogate package: substantive finite C2,C3,C7,C8 checks, C1,C4,C5,C6 surrogates; not a full P05 C-package, T17-I integrated instance, or full Temporal-FIACH

declaration_rules.stage_signatures: For stage index i in 0,1,2, predictive/order/tick/progress/record ranks equal i. Each mixed event contributes (1,1,1) to the later intervention projection, starting at (0,0,0).
declaration_rules.history_translation: Target numeric history order/tick/progress/record equals source value + corridor exit index 2; route sA/sB maps to rA/rB; source owner 17 maps to target owner 101.
declaration_rules.target_phase: History tick index modulo target tick modulus 2; controller actions toggle phase modulo 2.
declaration_rules.budget: Every controller action costs 2 and regenerates 2 through its carrier-owned retained regenerator; every state has budget 2. Underfunding sets regeneration to 0 on all target actions, without changing the declared transition table.
declaration_rules.package_assignments: Each target state has its own C1-C8 assignment. C1-C5 refer to raw finite audit structures; C6 uses state_ref and dynamics_ref with fixed q projection; C7/C8 refer to raw relation/kernel data. No success booleans or independent predictive-code labels.
declaration_rules.binding_probe: For each queried ordered branch pair, admit exactly when a raw reassembly row has that pair; hit actions query the left/right pair. This is a derived display, not a separate joint observable.
declaration_rules.route_arrival: Theory route rA arrives at T-A0a and rB at T-B0; each state retains its distinct route residue.
declaration_rules.past_histories: For each carrier, A0a and A0b are distinct histories with different declared predecessor health and generator provenance. Their predecessor records are outside the audited temporal episode; the local prehistory graph carries zero audited tick/progress/record increment, so both arrive at the same present TemporalSignature without asserting a hidden strict-record reset.

joint_binding.ambient_coupling_rule: all four functions from left slots {0,1} to right slots {0,1}

admissible_joint_observables.rule: from each raw coupling edge read the ordered (left content,right content) event; count events and divide by total edge count to form an exact rational distribution

joint_binding.branchwise_quotient_rule: on this assemblage domain, equality of complete ordered weighted predictive-class records for each independent branch
joint_binding.recombination_quotient_rule: on the same assemblage domain, equality of branchwise state and of exact event distributions for every raw admissible_joint_observables entry; branchwise readout is always included
joint_binding.binding_probe_rule: for a queried ordered branch pair, admit iff at least one raw reassembly row has that left and right branch; otherwise reject; derived display only

closure_audit.domain: powerset of the six declared kernel states
closure_audit.closure_rule: E_stage(A) is reflexive-transitive reachability of A under the stage allowed disturbances using the raw transition table; fixed sets satisfy E_stage(A)=A
closure_audit.defect_rule: for each A, compare one-step expansion D_stage(A)=A union successors(A) with E_stage(A); record exact symmetric-difference cardinality, with no prescribed small-defect threshold

perturbation.rule: P_epsilon=(1-epsilon)P+epsilon Uniform(K), where P is the equiprobable nominal/hit raw transition matrix; compute stationary fixed distributions and exact mass on CORE

closure_audit.surrogate_omission: This powerset reachability closure plus a separate Markov perturbation is not T1 exact E_tau=P^tau C U with pinned prototypes, idempotence defects, and its ten-state robustness audit.

promotion_readouts.factorization_defect_rule: all ordered state pairs with equal lower and unequal promoted readouts

self_profile.initial_partition_rule: equal complete current public observation (public report plus enabled disturbance set)
self_profile.refinement_rule: split each current class by, for each declared disturbance, raw action deltas, next maintenance/health and route observation, and next-state current partition class; iterate until no class splits
self_profile.terminal_target_rule: terminal equivalence equals equality of the fixed computed q on the declared kernel; q determines the package continuation coordinate (all future TemporalSignature traces)
self_profile.raw_continuation_coordinate: the complete future TemporalSignature trace function over all finite declared disturbance words, not an independently stored class label

exposure_channels.current_observation_rule: (public_state, enabled disturbance set) from raw state and transition table
exposure_channels.nonexposure_rule: there exist kernel states with equal complete current observation but different computed q and different future TemporalSignature observations
exposure_channels.surrogate_omission: The finite same-current/different-future collision establishes nonfactorization of q through the declared channels. It does not independently implement HIDD history/complexity visibility or resolve P05 literal no-nonconstant-observable-factors-through-M reading.

generator_provenance.credit_rule: For each protocol and each channel self/other, count directed raw edges on the u→v→w→u cycle and multiply their multiplicities; do the same on the reverse cycle. Exactly self-asymmetric gives self; exactly other-asymmetric gives other; both channel products equal gives none; simultaneous asymmetry is ambiguous. Generator owner/provenance must agree with the credited channel, except the internalized control is judged by the same balanced-products rule rather than its owner.
generator_provenance.surrogate_omission: No T5 nine-state 81-entry C+D lift or NG_ARROW_DPI audit is encoded.

value_translation_rules.identity_mod_2: equal phase after reducing target history tick modulo declared modulus 2
value_translation_rules.owner_17_to_101: map source carrier owner 17 to target carrier owner 101
value_translation_rules.carrier_prefix: replace leading source namespace S or source with target namespace T or target, retaining the remaining suffix
value_translation_rules.resource_prefix: map source resource name to target resource name with the same suffix
value_translation_rules.add_exit_stage_2: target numeric snapshot equals source snapshot plus corridor exit stage index 2
value_translation_rules.sA_to_rA_sB_to_rB: explicit route-code map sA→rA and sB→rB; preserve distinctness
value_translation_rules.computed_q: compute q from raw source/target states under the one fixed predictive_code_rule; compare by the raw state map
value_translation_rules.audit_ref_prefix: map source audit/table reference to corresponding target audit/table reference, then independently check its raw equations
value_translation_rules.split_pair_map: map both source split-pair state IDs through the explicit raw state map
value_translation_rules.state_ref_map: lookup explicit raw state map; no stored predictive label

staged_clause_map.joint_distribution_transport_rule: map paired-content events through branch_local_content_map and retain exact rational weights; require equality with target observable output on the mapped assemblage

intervention_rule.evaluate_by: componentwise sum of retained event contributions
